pages.title: Hammer It Home
pages.text: Change a Frame center support and a Pallet layer with the building Hammer.

pages.title: Hammer It Home
pages.text: Change construction details without replacing the palette; frames and beams continue that style.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Target the actual detail: frames, balustrades, columns, ladders, supports, mouldings and hooks expose variants; some use sneak-Hammer. Punching a frame removes its center.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Use the Hammer on supported frames, ladders, mouldings or fences. Cycle supports, styles or decorative parts through native block interactions.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Use a Hammer to change its layers, or sneak-right-click empty-handed. Change pallet height or its open/closed form.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Right-click a Frame with a Hammer to cycle its center support, or punch to remove the center. Edit the support; holding Frames/Hammers or crouching exposes the expanded hitbox according to settings.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Hammer balustrade ends, moulding dentils, stone-fence sides/pillars, column layers, ladder styles, supports or lantern hooks. Change the targeted detail; balustrade rotation and stone-fence pillar toggling use sneak-Hammer interaction.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Use an axe on a stripped Pale Log or Wood in different moon phases. Obtain phase-dependent carved variants; the tooltip displays the associated moon phase.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Existing BBB Hammer invokes Handcrafted native furniture-change contract; target the supported detail rather than creating another furniture system.
